text:
Nora (Marketing): Heads-up  an AP reporter in EMEA asked if they can publish our Optimize blog at 08:00 BST tomorrow instead of our scheduled 11:00 PT. They say its for their morning edition. Thoughts?
Ethan (PR): Who specifically? AP or an AP string? Any proof of assignment?
Nora (Marketing): Byline shows AP-Europe; they attached an embargo screenshot and asked for an "AP morning exclusive". No contract.
Sam (Product): Our planned messaging ties to a demo at 11:00 PT. Moving earlier would break the demo sync and AMER socials. Not ideal.
Tess (Social): If they go earlier, we lose our optimal social window. Also creatives are timed for 11:05 PT posting. We could flip but need +1hr notice to ops.
Clara (Legal): If there's no formal embargo agreement, this is a comms decision. We should avoid granting publish exclusives that break partner windows.
Ethan (PR): Proposal: Offer AP a controlled preview (read-only) at 08:00 BST, but maintain our live publish at 11:00 PT. Ask them to confirm they will not publish before 11:00 PT.
Nora (Marketing): Can we phrase it as: "We can provide an embargoed preview for assigned reporters at 08:00 BST; live publication remains 11:00 PT. Please confirm you will not publish prior to 11:00 PT."
Ethan (PR): Ill send that. Also ask for the reporters full contact and outlet lead so we can log it.
Tess (Social): If they insist on publishing at 08:00 BST, we need a contingency: quick social grab (one-liner + link) that ops can fire off. Ops, can you mobilize on 30m notice?
publish-bot: scheduled_post.create  post_id=optimize-2026-09; publish_time=11:00 PT at 1923456600
Sam (Product): Note: Demo live Q&A is at 11:15 PT; shifting publish earlier might confuse attendees. Also partner newsletters are queued for 11:30 PT.
Ethan (PR): Sent the preview offer. Pasted reply: ---
Hi  happy to provide an embargoed preview to your reporter at 08:00 BST. Live publication remains scheduled for 11:00 PT to coordinate our demo and partner distribution. Please confirm your reporter will not publish prior to 11:00 PT.
Best, Ethan (Redwood Inference)
---
Nora (Marketing): Good. Add a soft line: "We reserve the right to withdraw preview access if the embargo is breached."
Clara (Legal): Thats fine. Minimal legal: "Preview provided under embargo; publication prior to 11:00 PT without written consent is a breach."
Tess (Social): I'm preparing a 'fast-response' social text in case embargo is broken: short hero + fallback CTA. Uploading to drive.
Nora (Marketing): Action items: Ethan to log reporter and send preview link at 08:00 BST if they confirm; Tess to stage fast-response social; Ops to be on standby for manual publish if needed.
Ethan (PR): AP replied: reporter confirms will hold until 11:00 PT and thanks for the preview. They requested a short technical appendix; Sam can we provide that by 06:00 PT?
Sam (Product): Yes, can produce a 2-paragraph appendix and a small FAQ by 06:00 PT.
publish-bot: notification  assets_uploaded post_id=optimize-2026-09 by Sam at 1923456940
Tess (Social): Assets staged. Final check at 10:45 PT.
Nora (Marketing): Great. Leaving thread open for any last-minute embargo slips. Thanks all.
Ethan (PR): I'll update the reporter list and add a note to the embargo tracker.
